dinov2.rule: calibration m, p-values, flags and counts exact; scores within 1e-6 relative; bank digest exempt

fixture.rule: exact equality with the frozen test of reports/evaluation/basira.json

notes: VisA (Zou et al., 2022, "SPot-the-Difference Self-Supervised Pre-training for Anomaly Detection and Segmentation", arXiv:2207.14315), CC BY 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. Images were converted to 96×96 greyscale or resized for the model; no image is redistributed except the four 96 px examples shown.
Real public images (VisA), not MIZAN's own data. No escape-rate or industrial certificate follows from them.
The engine path submits each image as the engine itself would see it: greyscale, 96x96, PNG. dinov2-native sees the original colour image and is off the engine path.
Exchangeability: the false-alert promise rests on the test normals behaving like the calibration normals; the check compares the observed count with the exact distribution that assumption implies.
Many intervals are reported; none is adjusted for multiple comparisons.

provenance.note: HEAD and tracked-file state when the run started

settings.class_seed: the first 8 bytes, big-endian, of sha256('<seed>:<class>')
settings.engine_path: greyscale, bilinear resize to 96x96, PNG, submitted through basira.engine.decode_image

examples.pick: the lower median score of each set

gate.fixture: exact equality with the frozen test of reports/evaluation/basira.json

scorers.descriptor: the shipped hand-built descriptor on the engine path
scorers.dinov2-engine: models.dinov2_features on the engine path (the 96 px greyscale image)
scorers.dinov2-native: models.dinov2_features on the original colour image; off the engine path

split.order: train normals sorted by path; a later image whose decoded 96 px greyscale image repeats an earlier one is dropped and counted; then numpy.random.default_rng(class_seed).permutation
split.pools: the rest halved: the first half is the draw pool, the second half the evaluation pool
split.test: the official test normals and test anomalies, untouched

statistics.exchangeability: the long-run false-alert rate of the rank-k-of-m threshold is Beta(m-k+1, k); per class Beta-Binomial(n_test_normals, m-k+1, k), pooled by exact convolution; central 95% range and two-sided tail probability
statistics.multiplicity: no adjustment; stated on the pages

study.cap: m is capped by the draw pool

descriptor.note: Per-class rows are indicative; pooled rows average the classes with equal weight. No interval is reported for these shares.

dinov2-engine.note: Per-class rows are indicative; pooled rows average the classes with equal weight. No interval is reported for these shares.
